title.zh: 卷八 帝紀第八 孝宗穆帝 哀帝 廢帝海西公
title.en: Volume 8 Annals 8: Emperor Mu; Emperor Ai; Duke of Haixi
title.raw: 卷八 帝紀第八 孝宗穆帝 哀帝 廢帝海西公 Volume 8 Annals 8: Emperor Mu; Emperor Ai; Duke of Haixi

sentences.zh: 穆皇帝諱聃，字彭子，康帝子也。

translations.literal: The Revered Emperor Mu had the taboo name Dan, courtesy name Pengzi, and was a son of Emperor Kang.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Mu, whose personal name was Dan and courtesy name Pengzi, was the son of Emperor Kang.

sentences.zh: 建元二年九月丙申，立爲皇太子。

translations.literal: On the bingshen day of the ninth month of the second year of Jianyuan, he was established as crown prince.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month of the second year of the Jianyuan era (344 CE), on the day bingshen, he was named crown prince.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，康帝崩。

translations.literal: On the wuxu day, Emperor Kang died.
translations.idiomatic: The following day, wuxu, Emperor Kang passed away.

sentences.zh: 己亥，太子卽皇帝位，時年二歲。

translations.literal: On the jihai day, the crown prince assumed the imperial throne; at the time he was two sui in age.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai the crown prince ascended the throne at the age of two.

sentences.zh: 大赦，尊皇后爲皇太后。

translations.literal: A general amnesty was proclaimed, and the empress was honored as empress dowager.
translations.idiomatic: The court proclaimed a general amnesty and elevated the empress to empress dowager.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，皇太后臨朝攝政。

translations.literal: On the renyin day, the empress dowager assumed regency over the court from behind the screen.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin the empress dowager began to rule as regent.

sentences.zh: 冬十月乙丑，葬康皇帝于崇平陵。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter, on the yichou day, Emperor Kang was buried at Chongping Mausoleum.
translations.idiomatic: In winter, the tenth month, on yichou, Emperor Kang was interred at Chongping Ling.

sentences.zh: 十一月庚辰，車騎將軍庾冰卒。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on the gengchen day, General of Chariots and Cavalry Yu Bing died.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on gengchen, Yu Bing, general of chariots and cavalry, died.

sentences.zh: 永和元年春正月甲戌朔，皇太后設白紗帷於太極殿，抱帝臨軒。

translations.literal: In the first month of spring of the first year of Yonghe, on jiashu, the first day of the month, the empress dowager set up a white gauze curtain in the Hall of Supreme Ultimate, held the emperor, and faced the court from the gallery.
translations.idiomatic: In spring, the first month of the first Yonghe year (345), new moon on jiashu, the empress dowager hung a white gauze screen in the Taiji Hall, cradled the young emperor, and held audience from the front gallery.

sentences.zh: 改元。

translations.literal: The reign title was changed.
translations.idiomatic: The era name was changed to Yonghe.

sentences.zh: 甲申，進鎮軍將軍、武陵王晞爲鎮軍大將軍、開府儀同三司，以鎮軍將軍顧衆爲尚書右僕射。

translations.literal: On jiashen, Prince Xi of Wuling, general who stabilizes the army, was promoted to great general who stabilizes the army, with authority to open an office and parity of ceremony with the Three Dukes; Gu Zhong, general who stabilizes the army, was made right vice director of the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen Prince Xi of Wuling rose from general stabilizing the army to great general stabilizing the army with an independent office and Three-Dukes protocol, while Gu Zhong, who had held the latter post, was appointed right vice director of the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 夏四月壬戌，詔會稽王昱錄尚書六條事。

translations.literal: In summer, the fourth month, on renxu, an edict ordered Prince Hui of Kuaiji to supervise the six articles of business of the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth summer month, on renxu, the throne ordered Prince Hui of Kuaiji to take charge of the six portfolios of the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 五月戊寅，大雩。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on the wuyin day, a great rain prayer was held.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on wuyin, the court performed the great rain ceremony.

sentences.zh: 尚書令、金紫光祿大夫、建安伯諸葛恢卒。

translations.literal: Director of the Secretariat, grandee with golden purple and splendid brilliance, Marquis Jian’an Zhuge Hui died.
translations.idiomatic: Zhuge Hui, director of the Secretariat, grandee of the golden purple splendor rank, and Marquis of Jian’an, died.

sentences.zh: 六月癸亥，地震。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on the guihai day, there was an earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on guihai, an earthquake struck.

sentences.zh: 秋七月庚午，持節、都尉江荊司梁雍益寧七州諸軍事、江州刺史、征西將軍、都亭侯庾翼卒。

translations.literal: In autumn, the seventh month, on gengwu, Yu Yi, bearer of credentials, commandant, commander-in-chief of military affairs in the seven provinces of Jiang, Jing, Si, Liang, Yong, Yi, and Ning, governor of Jiang, general who campaigns west, and village marquis of Duting, died.
translations.idiomatic: In autumn, the seventh month, on gengwu, Yu Yi died—he had held the staff of authority, commanded armies across Jiang, Jing, Si, Liang, Yong, Yi, and Ning, governed Jiang Province, led the western expedition, and held the Duting village marquisate.

sentences.zh: 翼部將于瓚、戴羲等殺冠軍將軍曹據，舉兵反，安西司馬朱燾討平之。

translations.literal: Yu Yi’s subordinate officers Yu Zan, Dai Xi, and others killed General Who Vanquishes Champions Cao Ju, raised troops in revolt, and Marshal of the West Zhu Xi campaigned and pacified them.
translations.idiomatic: Subordinates of Yu Yi, Yu Zan and Dai Xi among them, murdered General Who Vanquishes Champions Cao Ju and mutinied; Zhu Xi, marshal on the western front, crushed the rising.

sentences.zh: 八月，豫州刺史路永叛奔于石季龍。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, Lu Yong, governor of Yu, rebelled and fled to Shi Jilong.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month Lu Yong, governor of Yu, defected to Shi Hu (Shi Jilong).

sentences.zh: 庚辰，以輔國將軍、徐州刺史桓溫爲安西將軍、持節、都督荊司雍益梁寧六州諸軍事，領護南蠻校尉、荊州刺史。

translations.literal: On gengchen, Huan Wen, general who supports the state and governor of Xu, was made general who pacifies the west, bearer of credentials, commander-in-chief of military affairs in the six provinces of Jing, Si, Yong, Yi, Liang, and Ning, concurrently colonel of the southern Man, and governor of Jing.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen Huan Wen was promoted from general supporting the state and governor of Xu to general pacifying the west, given the staff, placed over Jing, Si, Yong, Yi, Liang, and Ning, named colonel of the southern Man, and made governor of Jing.

sentences.zh: 石季龍將路永屯于壽春。

translations.literal: The general of Shi Jilong, Lu Yong, encamped at Shouchun.
translations.idiomatic: Shi Hu’s general Lu Yong took position at Shouchun.

sentences.zh: 九月丙申，皇太后詔曰：「今百姓勞弊，其共思詳所以振卹之宜。

translations.literal: On bingshen of the ninth month, the empress dowager issued an edict saying: “Now the hundred surnames are worn out and exhausted; together ponder in detail the measures appropriate for relief and succor.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on bingshen, the empress dowager proclaimed: “The people are exhausted; let officials everywhere consider carefully how best to bring them relief.

sentences.zh: 及歲常調非軍國要急者，並宜停之。」

translations.literal: As for the annual regular levies that are not urgently required for the army and state, all alike should halt them.”
translations.idiomatic: Routine annual levies that are not vital to army or state should all be suspended.”

sentences.zh: 冬十二月，李勢將爨頠來奔。

translations.literal: In winter, the twelfth month, Cuan Yi, a general of Li Shi, came to surrender.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth winter month Cuan Yi, a commander under Li Shi, came over to the Jin side.

sentences.zh: 涼州牧張駿伐焉耆，降之。

translations.literal: Shepherd of Liang Zhang Jun campaigned against Yanqi and made it submit.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Jun, governor of Liang, attacked Yanqi and forced its submission.

sentences.zh: 二年春正月丙寅，大赦。

translations.literal: In the second year, spring, the first month, on bingyin, a general amnesty was proclaimed.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year, spring, first month, on bingyin, a general amnesty was declared.

sentences.zh: 己卯，使持節、侍中、都督揚州諸軍事、揚州刺史、驃騎將軍、錄尚書事、都鄉侯何充卒。

translations.literal: On jimao, He Chong, bearer of credentials, palace attendant, commander-in-chief of military affairs in Yang, governor of Yang, general of agile cavalry, supervisor of Secretariat business, and village marquis of Duxiang, died.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao He Chong died—he had carried the staff, served in the palace, commanded Yang Province, led the agile cavalry, overseen the six portfolios, and held the Duxiang marquisate.

sentences.zh: 二月癸丑，以左光祿大夫葵謨領司徒，錄尚書六條事、撫軍大將軍、會稽王昱及謨並輔政。

translations.literal: On guichou of the second month, with senior grandee of the left for splendid emolument Cai Mo as acting director of the Secretariat, Prince Hui of Kuaiji, great general who nurtures the army, supervisor of the six articles of Secretariat business, and Mo together assisted the government.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou in the second month Cai Mo, senior grandee of the left with splendid emolument, took acting charge of the Secretariat while Prince Hui of Kuaiji, great general nurturing the army and supervisor of the six portfolios, served with him as co-regent.

sentences.zh: 三月丙子，以前司徒左長史殷浩爲建武將軍、揚州刺史。

translations.literal: On bingzi of the third month, with former senior administrator of the left of the directorate Yin Hao as general who establishes martial prowess and governor of Yang.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi Yin Hao, formerly senior administrator on the left of the Secretariat, was appointed general establishing martial prowess and governor of Yang.

sentences.zh: 夏四月己酉朔，日有蝕之。

translations.literal: In summer, the fourth month, on jiyou, the first day of the month, there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: At new moon on jiyou in the fourth summer month there was an eclipse of the sun.

sentences.zh: 五月丙戌，涼州牧張駿卒，子重華嗣。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on bingxu, Shepherd of Liang Zhang Jun died; his son Chonghua succeeded.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on bingxu, Zhang Jun, governor of Liang, died and was succeeded by his son Zhang Chonghua.

sentences.zh: 六月。

translations.literal: The sixth month.
translations.idiomatic: Sixth month (no major entry).

sentences.zh: 石季龍將王擢襲武街，執張重華護軍胡宣。

translations.literal: The general of Shi Jilong, Wang Zhuo, raided Wujie and seized Hu Xuan, protector of Zhang Chonghua.
translations.idiomatic: Shi Hu’s general Wang Zhuo struck Wujie and captured Hu Xuan, Zhang Chonghua’s protector-general.

sentences.zh: 又使麻秋、孫伏都伐金城，太守張沖降之。

translations.literal: He also sent Ma Qiu and Sun Fudu to campaign against Jincheng; Prefect Zhang Chong surrendered to them.
translations.idiomatic: He also dispatched Ma Qiu and Sun Fudu against Jincheng, whose prefect Zhang Chong yielded.

sentences.zh: 重華將謝艾擊秋，敗之。

translations.literal: The general of Chonghua, Xie Ai, struck Ma Qiu and defeated him.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Chonghua’s commander Xie Ai attacked Ma Qiu and routed him.

sentences.zh: 秋七月，以兗州刺史褚裒爲征北大將軍，開府儀同三司。

translations.literal: In autumn, the seventh month, Chu Pou, governor of Yan, was made general who campaigns north, with authority to open an office and parity of ceremony with the Three Dukes.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh autumn month Chu Pou, governor of Yan, was promoted to general campaigning north with an independent office and Three-Dukes protocol.

sentences.zh: 冬十月，地震。

translations.literal: In winter, the tenth month, there was an earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth winter month the earth shook.

sentences.zh: 十一月辛未，安西將軍桓溫帥征虜將軍周撫，輔國將軍、譙王無忌，建武將軍袁喬伐蜀，拜表輒行。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on xinwei, General Who Pacifies the West Huan Wen led General Who Campaigns Against Caitiffs Zhou Fu, General Who Supports the State and Prince Wuji of Qiao, General Who Establishes Martial Prowess Yuan Qiao, to campaign against Shu, submitted a memorial and set out at once.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei in the eleventh month Huan Wen, general pacifying the west, marched on Shu at the head of Zhou Fu, Yuan Qiao, and Prince Wuji of Qiao, filing his plan and moving without waiting for further orders.

sentences.zh: 十二月，枉矢自東南流於西北，其長竟天。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, a crooked arrow-streak flew from the southeast toward the northwest; its length spanned the sky.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month a comet-like “crooked arrow” streaked from southeast to northwest across the full vault of heaven.

sentences.zh: 三年春正月乙卯，桓溫攻成都，克之。

translations.literal: In the third year, spring, the first month, on yimao, Huan Wen attacked Chengdu and took it.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year, spring, first month, on yimao, Huan Wen assaulted Chengdu and captured it.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，李勢降，益州平。

translations.literal: On dinghai, Li Shi surrendered, and Yi Province was pacified.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai Li Shi capitulated and Shu was pacified.

sentences.zh: 林邑范文攻陷日南，害太守夏侯覽，以尸祭天。

translations.literal: Fan Wen of Linyi attacked and took Rinan, killed Prefect Xiahou Lan, and used the corpse to sacrifice to Heaven.
translations.idiomatic: Fan Wen of Linyi overran Rinan, slew Prefect Xiahou Lan, and offered his body in a sacrifice to Heaven.

sentences.zh: 夏四月，地震。

translations.literal: In summer, the fourth month, there was an earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth summer month there was an earthquake.

sentences.zh: 蜀人鄧定、隗文舉兵反，桓溫又擊破之，使益州刺史周撫鎮彭模。

translations.literal: The Shu men Deng Ding and Wei Wen raised troops in revolt; Huan Wen again broke them and ordered Governor of Yi Zhou Fu to garrison Pengmo.
translations.idiomatic: Deng Ding and Wei Wen of Shu rose again; Huan Wen defeated them and stationed Zhou Fu as governor of Yi at Pengmo.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，鄧定、隗文復入據成都，征虜將軍楊謙棄涪城，退保德陽。

translations.literal: On dingsi, Deng Ding and Wei Wen again entered and occupied Chengdu; General Who Campaigns Against Caitiffs Yang Qian abandoned Fucheng and withdrew to guard Deyang.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi Deng Ding and Wei Wen reoccupied Chengdu; Yang Qian, general campaigning against caitiffs, abandoned Fucheng and fell back to Deyang.

sentences.zh: 五月戊申，進慕容皝爲安北將軍。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on wushen, Murong Huang was advanced to general who pacifies the north.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on wushen, Murong Huang was promoted to general pacifying the north.

sentences.zh: 石季龍又使其將石寧、麻秋等伐涼州，次於曲柳。

translations.literal: Shi Jilong again sent his generals Shi Ning, Ma Qiu, and others to campaign against Liang Province, halting at Quliu.
translations.idiomatic: Shi Hu again sent Shi Ning, Ma Qiu, and others against Liang, halting their advance at Quliu.

sentences.zh: 張重華使將軍牛旋禦之，退守枹罕。

translations.literal: Zhang Chonghua sent General Niu Xuan to oppose them; he withdrew to defend Fuhan.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Chonghua sent Niu Xuan to meet them but pulled back to hold Fuhan.

sentences.zh: 六月辛酉，大赦。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on xinyou, a general amnesty was proclaimed.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on xinyou, a general amnesty was issued.

sentences.zh: 秋七月，范文復陷日南，害督護劉雄。

translations.literal: In autumn, the seventh month, Fan Wen again took Rinan and killed Superintendent Liu Xiong.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh autumn month Fan Wen seized Rinan again and killed protector Liu Xiong.

sentences.zh: 隗文立范賁爲帝。

translations.literal: Wei Wen established Fan Ben as emperor.
translations.idiomatic: Wei Wen set up Fan Ben as ruler.

sentences.zh: 八月戊午，張重華將謝艾進擊麻秋，大敗之。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on wuwu, the general of Zhang Chonghua, Xie Ai, advanced to attack Ma Qiu and greatly defeated him.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu in the eighth month Xie Ai, Zhang Chonghua’s commander, struck Ma Qiu and won a crushing victory.

sentences.zh: 九月，地震。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, there was an earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month the earth trembled.

sentences.zh: 冬十月乙丑，假涼州刺史張重華大都督隴右關中諸軍事、護羌校尉、大將軍，武都氐王楊初爲征南將軍、雍州刺史、平羌校尉、仇池公，並假節。

translations.literal: In winter, the tenth month, on yichou, acting Governor of Liang Zhang Chonghua was given overall command of military affairs in Longyou and Guanzhong, colonel protecting the Qiang, and great general; King of the Di of Wudu Yang Chu was made general who campaigns south, governor of Yong, colonel pacifying the Qiang, and Duke of Qiuchi, both with credential staffs.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou in the tenth winter month Zhang Chonghua was confirmed acting governor of Liang with broad command over Longyou and Guanzhong, Qiang colonelcy, and full general’s rank, while Yang Chu, Di king of Wudu, became general campaigning south, governor of Yong, pacification colonel of the Qiang, and duke of Qiuchi—both appointments carried the ceremonial staff.

sentences.zh: 十二月，振威護軍蕭敬文害征虜將軍楊謙，攻涪城，陷之。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, General Who Rouses Might Xiao Jingwen killed General Who Campaigns Against Caitiffs Yang Qian, attacked Fucheng, and took it.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month Xiao Jingwen, general rousing might, murdered Yang Qian, stormed Fucheng, and captured it.

sentences.zh: 遂取巴西，通于漢中。

translations.literal: Thereupon he took Ba and opened communication with Hanzhong.
translations.idiomatic: He then overran Ba commandery and opened a corridor into Hanzhong.

sentences.zh: 四年夏四月，范文寇九德，多所殺害。

translations.literal: In the fourth year, summer, the fourth month, Fan Wen raided Jiude and killed many.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year, fourth summer month, Fan Wen pillaged Jiude with heavy slaughter.

sentences.zh: 五月，大水。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, great flooding.
translations.idiomatic: The fifth month brought severe floods.

sentences.zh: 秋八月，進安西將軍桓溫爲征西大將軍、開府儀同三司，封臨賀郡公；

translations.literal: In autumn, the eighth month, General Who Pacifies the West Huan Wen was advanced to great general who campaigns west, with authority to open an office and parity of ceremony with the Three Dukes, and enfeoffed as duke of Linhe commandery;
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth autumn month Huan Wen rose to great general campaigning west with an independent office, Three-Dukes honors, and the title of duke of Linhe;

sentences.zh: 西中郎將謝尚爲安西將軍。

translations.literal: General of the West Central Command Xie Shang was made General Who Pacifies the West.
translations.idiomatic: Xie Shang, general of the central west command, became general pacifying the west.

sentences.zh: 九月丙申，慕容皝死，子儁嗣偽位。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on bingshen, Murong Huang died; his son Jun succeeded to the false position.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen in the ninth month Murong Huang died and his son Murong Jun inherited the usurper’s throne.

sentences.zh: 冬十月己未，地震。

translations.literal: In winter, the tenth month, on jiwei, there was an earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei in the tenth winter month there was an earthquake.

sentences.zh: 石季龍使其將苻健寇竟陵。

translations.literal: Shi Jilong sent his general Fu Jian to raid Jingling.
translations.idiomatic: Shi Hu sent Fu Jian against Jingling.

sentences.zh: 十二月，豫章人黃韜自號孝神皇帝，聚衆數千，寇臨川，太守庾條討平之。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, Huang Tao of Yuzhang styled himself Emperor Xiaoshen, gathered several thousand men, raided Linchuan, and Prefect Yu Tiao campaigned and pacified him.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month Huang Tao of Yuzhang declared himself “Emperor Xiaoshen,” mustered several thousand followers, struck Linchuan, and was put down by Prefect Yu Tiao.

sentences.zh: 五年春正月辛巳朔，大赦。

translations.literal: In the fifth year, spring, the first month, on xinsi, the first day of the month, a general amnesty was proclaimed.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year, at new moon on xinsi in the first spring month, a general amnesty was proclaimed.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，地震。

translations.literal: On gengyin, there was an earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin the earth shook.

sentences.zh: 石季龍僭卽皇帝位于鄴。

translations.literal: Shi Jilong usurped and assumed the imperial throne position at Ye.
translations.idiomatic: Shi Hu proclaimed himself emperor at Ye.

sentences.zh: 二月，征北大將軍褚裒使部將王龕北伐，獲石季龍將支重。

translations.literal: In the second month, Great General Who Campaigns North Chu Pou sent his subordinate Wang Kan on a northern campaign and captured the general of Shi Jilong, Zhi Zhong.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month Chu Pou, great general campaigning north, sent Wang Kan north and took Zhi Zhong, one of Shi Hu’s generals, prisoner.

sentences.zh: 夏四月，益州刺史周撫、龍驤將軍朱燾擊范賁，獲之，益州平。

translations.literal: In summer, the fourth month, Governor of Yi Zhou Fu and General of Dragon Martial Zhu Xi struck Fan Ben, captured him, and Yi Province was pacified.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth summer month Zhou Fu, governor of Yi, and Zhu Xi, dragon martial general, defeated Fan Ben, took him alive, and restored order in Shu.

sentences.zh: 封周撫爲建城公。

translations.literal: Zhou Fu was enfeoffed as duke of Jiancheng.
translations.idiomatic: Zhou Fu was ennobled duke of Jiancheng.

sentences.zh: 假慕容儁大將軍、幽平二州牧、大單于、燕王。

translations.literal: Murong Jun was given acting appointment as great general, shepherd of You and Ping, supreme chieftain, and king of Yan.
translations.idiomatic: Murong Jun received brevet rank as great general, governor of You and Ping, great shanyu, and king of Yan.

sentences.zh: 征西大將軍桓溫遣督軍滕畯討范文，爲文所敗。

translations.literal: Great General Who Campaigns West Huan Wen sent Superintendent of the Army Teng Jun to campaign against Fan Wen, and was defeated by Wen.
translations.idiomatic: Huan Wen sent Teng Jun against Fan Wen and suffered a defeat at Fan Wen’s hands.

sentences.zh: 石季龍死，子世嗣偽位。

translations.literal: Shi Jilong died; his son Shi succeeded to the false position.
translations.idiomatic: Shi Hu died and his son Shi Shi inherited the usurping regime.

sentences.zh: 五月，石遵廢世而自立。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, Shi Zun deposed Shi and established himself.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month Shi Zun ousted Shi Shi and seized the throne.

sentences.zh: 六月，桓溫屯安陸，遣諸將討河北。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, Huan Wen encamped at Anlu and sent various generals to campaign against the north of the He.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month Huan Wen camped at Anlu and dispatched generals toward the north bank of the Yellow River.

sentences.zh: 石遵揚州刺史王浹以壽陽來降。

translations.literal: Shi Zun’s governor of Yang, Wang Jian, came with Shouyang to surrender.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Jian, Shi Zun’s governor of Yang, brought Shouyang over to Jin.

sentences.zh: 秋七月，褚裒進次彭城，遣部將王龕、李邁及石遵將李農戰于代陂，王師敗績，王龕爲農所執，李邁死之。

translations.literal: In autumn, the seventh month, Chu Pou advanced and halted at Pengcheng, sent subordinates Wang Kan, Li Mai, and Shi Zun’s general Li Nong to battle at Daibo; the royal army was routed, Wang Kan was seized alive by Nong, and Li Mai died in the affair.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh autumn month Chu Pou pushed to Pengcheng and threw Wang Kan and Li Mai against Li Nong of Zhao at Daibo; the imperial army was shattered, Wang Kan captured, and Li Mai killed.

sentences.zh: 八月，褚裒退屯廣陵，西中郎將陳逵焚壽春而遁。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, Chu Pou withdrew to encamp at Guangling; General of the West Central Command Chen Kui burned Shouchun and fled.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month Chu Pou fell back to Guangling while Chen Kui of the central west command torched Shouchun and retreated.

sentences.zh: 梁州刺史司馬勳功石遵長城戍，仇池公楊初襲西城，皆破之。

translations.literal: Governor of Liang Sima Xun attacked Shi Zun’s Changcheng garrison; Duke of Qiuchi Yang Chu raided Xicheng; both broke them.
translations.idiomatic: Sima Xun, governor of Liang, stormed Shi Zun’s outpost at Changcheng, while Yang Chu, duke of Qiuchi, struck Xicheng; both operations succeeded.

sentences.zh: 冬十月，石遵將石遇攻宛，陷之，執南陽太守郭啓。

translations.literal: In winter, the tenth month, the general of Shi Zun, Shi Yu, attacked Wan, took it, and seized Nanyang Prefect Guo Qi.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth winter month Shi Yu, Shi Zun’s general, stormed Wan, captured it, and took Nanyang’s prefect Guo Qi prisoner.

sentences.zh: 司馬勳進次懸鉤，石季龍故將麻秋距之，勳退還梁州。

translations.literal: Sima Xun advanced and halted at Xuangu; the former general of Shi Jilong, Ma Qiu, opposed him; Xun withdrew to Liang Province.
translations.idiomatic: Sima Xun advanced to Xuangu but Ma Qiu, once Shi Hu’s commander, blocked him, so he pulled back to Liang Province.

sentences.zh: 十一月丙辰，石鑒弑石遵而自立。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on bingchen, Shi Jian murdered Shi Zun and established himself.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen in the eleventh month Shi Jian assassinated Shi Zun and claimed power.

sentences.zh: 十二月己酉，使持節、都督徐兗二州諸軍事、徐州刺史、征北大將軍、開府儀同三司、都鄉侯褚裒卒。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on jiyou, Chu Pou, bearer of credentials, commander-in-chief of military affairs in Xu and Yan, governor of Xu, general who campaigns north, with authority to open an office and parity of ceremony with the Three Dukes, and village marquis of Duxiang, died.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou in the twelfth month Chu Pou died—he had held the staff, commanded Xu and Yan, governed Xu, led the northern expedition, opened his own office, matched the Three Dukes, and borne the Duxiang marquisate.

sentences.zh: 以建武將軍、吳國內史荀羨爲使持節、監徐兗二州諸軍事、北中郎將、徐州刺史。

translations.literal: With Jianwu general and administrator of the interior of Wu, Xun Xian, as bearer of credentials, supervisor of military affairs in Xu and Yan, north central commandant, and governor of Xu.
translations.idiomatic: Xun Xian, general establishing martial prowess and interior administrator of Wu, was appointed credential-holder supervising Xu and Yan, north central commandant, and governor of Xu.

sentences.zh: 六年春正月，帝臨朝，以褚裒喪故，懸而不樂。

translations.literal: In the sixth year, spring, the first month, the emperor faced the court; because of Chu Pou’s mourning, it was suspended and there was no music.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year, first spring month, the emperor held court but, mourning Chu Pou, suspended the usual music.

sentences.zh: 閏月，冉閔弑石鑒，僭稱天王，國號魏。

translations.literal: In the intercalary month, Ran Min murdered Shi Jian, usurped the title of celestial king, and the state designation was Wei.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary month Ran Min killed Shi Jian, styled himself heavenly king, and called his regime Wei.

sentences.zh: 鑒弟祗僭帝號于襄國。

translations.literal: The younger brother of Jian, Zhi, usurped the imperial title at Xiangguo.
translations.idiomatic: Shi Zhi, Shi Jian’s brother, declared himself emperor at Xiangguo.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，彗星見于亢。

translations.literal: On dingchou, a comet appeared in Kang.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou a comet appeared in the Kang lunar lodge.

sentences.zh: 己丑，加中軍將軍殷浩督揚豫徐兗青五州諸軍事、假節。

translations.literal: On jichou, Central Army General Yin Hao was added supervisor of military affairs in the five provinces of Yang, Yu, Xu, Yan, and Qing, with credential staff.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou Yin Hao, central army general, was given command over Yang, Yu, Xu, Yan, and Qing with a ceremonial staff.

sentences.zh: 氐帥苻洪遣使來降，以爲氐王，封廣川郡公。

translations.literal: The Di chieftain Fu Hong sent envoys to come surrender; he was made king of the Di and enfeoffed as duke of Guangchuan commandery.
translations.idiomatic: Di leader Fu Hong offered submission and was recognized as king of the Di and duke of Guangchuan.

sentences.zh: 假洪子健節，監河北諸軍事、右將軍，封襄國縣公。

translations.literal: Hong’s son Jian was given credential staff, supervisor of military affairs north of the He, general of the right, and enfeoffed as duke of Xiangguo county.
translations.idiomatic: His son Fu Jian received the staff, oversight of Hebei, rank of general of the right, and the county dukedom of Xiangguo.

sentences.zh: 三月，石季龍故將麻秋鴆殺苻洪于枋頭。

translations.literal: In the third month, the former general of Shi Jilong, Ma Qiu, poisoned Fu Hong to death at Fangtou.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month Ma Qiu, once Shi Hu’s commander, poisoned Fu Hong at Fangtou.

sentences.zh: 夏五月，大水。

translations.literal: In summer, the fifth month, great flooding.
translations.idiomatic: The fifth summer month brought catastrophic floods.

sentences.zh: 廬江太守袁眞攻合肥，克之。

translations.literal: Prefect of Lujiang Yuan Zhen attacked Hefei and took it.
translations.idiomatic: Yuan Zhen, prefect of Lujiang, attacked and captured Hefei.

sentences.zh: 六月，石祗遣其弟琨攻冉閔將王泰于邯鄲，琨師敗績。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, Shi Zhi sent his younger brother Kun to attack Ran Min’s general Wang Tai at Handan; Kun’s army was routed.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month Shi Zhi sent Shi Kun against Wang Tai at Handan; Shi Kun’s force was routed.

sentences.zh: 秋八月，輔國將軍、譙王無忌薨。

translations.literal: In autumn, the eighth month, General Who Supports the State and Prince Wuji of Qiao died.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth autumn month Prince Wuji of Qiao, general supporting the state, died.

sentences.zh: 苻健帥衆入關。

translations.literal: Fu Jian led the host into the passes.
translations.idiomatic: Fu Jian marched his army through the passes into Guanzhong.

sentences.zh: 冬十一月，冉閔圍襄國。

translations.literal: In winter, the eleventh month, Ran Min besieged Xiangguo.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh winter month Ran Min laid siege to Xiangguo.

sentences.zh: 十二月，免司徒蔡謨爲庶人。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, Director of the Secretariat Cai Mo was dismissed to commoner status.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month Cai Mo was stripped of his post as director of the Secretariat and reduced to commoner rank.

sentences.zh: 是歲，大疫。

translations.literal: In this year, great pestilence.
translations.idiomatic: That year a great plague ravaged the realm.

sentences.zh: 七年春正月丁酉，日有蝕之。

translations.literal: In the seventh year, spring, the first month, on dingyou, there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year, first spring month, on dingyou, the sun was eclipsed.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，鮮卑段龕以青州來降。

translations.literal: On xinchou, the Xianbei Duan Kan came with Qing Province to surrender.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou the Xianbei leader Duan Kan brought Qing Province over to Jin.

sentences.zh: 苻健僭稱王，國號秦。

translations.literal: Fu Jian usurped the title of king; the state designation was Qin.
translations.idiomatic: Fu Jian declared himself king of the state he called Qin.

sentences.zh: 二月戊寅，以段龕爲鎮北將軍，封齊公。

translations.literal: In the second month, on the wuyin day, with Duan Kan as general who stabilizes the north, enfeoffed as duke of Qi.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin in the second month Duan Kan was named general stabilizing the north and ennobled duke of Qi.

sentences.zh: 石祗大敗冉閔于襄國。

translations.literal: Shi Zhi greatly defeated Ran Min at Xiangguo.
translations.idiomatic: Shi Zhi inflicted a crushing defeat on Ran Min at Xiangguo.

sentences.zh: 夏四月，梁州刺史司馬勳出步騎三萬，自漢中入秦川，與苻健戰于五丈原，王師敗績。

translations.literal: In summer, the fourth month, Governor of Liang Sima Xun led thirty thousand foot and horse out of Hanzhong into Qinchuan, and with Fu Jian battled at Wuzhangyuan; the royal army was routed.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth summer month Sima Xun, governor of Liang, marched thirty thousand troops from Hanzhong into the Guanzhong plain and met Fu Jian at Wuzhangyuan; the imperial army was routed.

sentences.zh: 加尚書令顧和開府儀同三司。

translations.literal: Director of the Secretariat Gu He was added authority to open an office and parity of ceremony with the Three Dukes.
translations.idiomatic: Gu He, director of the Secretariat, was granted an independent office with Three-Dukes protocol.

sentences.zh: 劉顯殺石祗。

translations.literal: Liu Xian killed Shi Zhi.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Xian murdered Shi Zhi.

sentences.zh: 五月，祗兗州刺史劉啓自鄄城來奔。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, Shi Zhi’s governor of Yanzhou, Liu Qi, came in flight from Juancheng.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month Liu Qi, whom Shi Zhi had appointed governor of Yanzhou, fled from Juancheng to the Jin court.

sentences.zh: 秋七月，尚書令、左光祿大夫、開府儀同三司顧和卒。

translations.literal: In autumn, the seventh month, Director of the Secretariat, senior grandee of the left for splendid emolument, with authority to open an office and parity of ceremony with the Three Dukes, Gu He, died.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh autumn month Gu He died—director of the Secretariat, left grandee with splendid stipend, and holder of a Three-Dukes office.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，濤水入石頭，溺死者數百人。

translations.literal: On jiachen, the Tao waters entered Shitou; those drowned numbered in the hundreds.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen the Tao River burst into Shitou, drowning hundreds.

sentences.zh: 八月，冉閔豫州牧張遇以許昌來降，拜鎮西將軍。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, Ran Min’s shepherd of Yu, Zhang Yu, came with Xuchang to surrender; he was appointed general who pacifies the west.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month Zhang Yu, whom Ran Min had made governor of Yu, surrendered Xuchang and was named general pacifying the west.

sentences.zh: 九月，峻陽、太陽二陵崩。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, the two mausoleums Junyang and Taiyang collapsed.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month the imperial tombs Junyang and Taiyang gave way.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，帝素服臨于太極殿三日，遣兼太常趙拔修復山陵。

translations.literal: On jiachen, the emperor in plain garment faced [the matter] at the Hall of Supreme Ultimate for three days, and sent concurrent Minister of Ceremonies Zhao Ba to repair the mountain tombs.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen the emperor, dressed in mourning white, kept vigil in the Taiji Hall for three days and dispatched Zhao Ba, acting minister of ceremonials, to restore the hillside mausolea.

sentences.zh: 冬十月，雷雨，震電。

translations.literal: In winter, the tenth month, there was thunder, rain, and lightning.
translations.idiomatic: The tenth winter month brought thunderstorms and lightning.

sentences.zh: 十一月，石祗將姚弋仲、冉閔將魏脫各遣使來降，以弋仲爲車騎將軍、大單于，封高陵郡公；

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, Shi Zhi’s general Yao Yizhong and Ran Min’s general Wei Tuo each sent envoys to come surrender; with Yao Yizhong as general of chariots and cavalry, supreme chieftain, enfeoffed as duke of Gaoling commandery;
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month Yao Yizhong, a general of Shi Zhi, and Wei Tuo, a general of Ran Min, each offered submission; Yao Yizhong became general of chariots and cavalry, great shanyu, and duke of Gaoling;

sentences.zh: 弋仲子襄爲平北將軍、都督幷州諸軍事、幷州刺史、平鄉縣公；

translations.literal: Yizhong’s son Xiang as general who pacifies the north, commander-in-chief of military affairs in Bing Province, governor of Bing, and duke of Pingxiang county;
translations.idiomatic: his son Yao Xiang received rank as general pacifying the north, commander over Bing, governor of Bing, and duke of Pingxiang;

sentences.zh: 脫爲安北將軍、監冀州諸軍事、冀州刺史。

translations.literal: Tuo as general who pacifies the north, supervisor of military affairs in Ji Province, and governor of Ji.
translations.idiomatic: Wei Tuo was named general pacifying the north, supervisor of Ji, and governor of Ji.

sentences.zh: 十二月辛未，征西大將軍桓溫帥衆北伐，次于武昌而止。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on xinwei, Great General Who Campaigns West Huan Wen led the host on a northern campaign, halted at Wuchang, and stopped.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei in the twelfth month Huan Wen marched north but halted at Wuchang and went no farther.

sentences.zh: 時石季龍故將周成屯廩丘，高昌屯野王，樂立屯許昌，李歷屯衛國，皆相次來降。

translations.literal: At the time the former generals of Shi Jilong, Zhou Cheng encamped at Linqiu, Gao Chang at Yewang, Yue Li at Xuchang, and Li Li at Weiguo, in succession all came to surrender.
translations.idiomatic: Former commanders of Shi Hu—Zhou Cheng at Linqiu, Gao Chang at Yewang, Yue Li at Xuchang, and Li Li at Weiguo—surrendered one after another.

sentences.zh: 八年春正月辛卯，日有蝕之。

translations.literal: In the eighth year, spring, the first month, on xinmao, there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year, first spring month, on xinmao, the sun was eclipsed.

sentences.zh: 劉顯僭帝號于襄國，冉閔擊破，殺之。

translations.literal: Liu Xian usurped the imperial title at Xiangguo; Ran Min attacked, broke him, and killed him.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Xian declared himself emperor at Xiangguo; Ran Min crushed him and put him to death.

sentences.zh: 苻健僭帝號于長安。

translations.literal: Fu Jian usurped the imperial title at Chang’an.
translations.idiomatic: Fu Jian proclaimed himself emperor at Chang’an.

sentences.zh: 二月，峻平、崇陽二陵崩。

translations.literal: In the second month, the two mausoleums Junping and Chongyang collapsed.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month the tombs Junping and Chongyang collapsed.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，帝臨三日，遣殿中都尉王惠如洛陽，以衛五陵。

translations.literal: On wuchen, the emperor faced [the matter] for three days, and sent Palace Commandant Wang Hui to Luoyang to guard the five mausoleums.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen the emperor mourned three days and sent Wang Hui, commandant of the palace corps, to Luoyang to secure the five Jin tombs.

sentences.zh: 鎮西將軍張遇反于許昌，使其黨上官恩據洛陽。

translations.literal: General Who Pacifies the West Zhang Yu rebelled at Xuchang, and sent his partisan Shangguan En to occupy Luoyang.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Yu, general pacifying the west, mutinied at Xuchang and had Shangguan En seize Luoyang.

sentences.zh: 樂弘攻督護戴施於倉垣。

translations.literal: Yue Hong attacked Superintendent Dai Shi at Cangyuan.
translations.idiomatic: Yue Hong assaulted protector Dai Shi at Cangyuan.

sentences.zh: 三月，使北中郎荀羨鎮淮陰。

translations.literal: In the third month, they sent North Central Commandant Xun Xian to garrison Huaiyin.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month Xun Xian, north central commandant, was posted to Huaiyin.

sentences.zh: 苻健別帥侵順陽，太守薛珍擊破之。

translations.literal: A separate commander of Fu Jian raided Shunyang; Prefect Xue Zhen attacked and broke him.
translations.idiomatic: A detached column of Fu Jian’s raided Shunyang, but Prefect Xue Zhen drove it back.

sentences.zh: 夏四月，冉閔爲慕容儁所滅。

translations.literal: In summer, the fourth month, Ran Min was extinguished by Murong Jun.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth summer month Murong Jun destroyed Ran Min.

sentences.zh: 儁僭帝號于中山，稱燕。

translations.literal: Jun usurped the imperial title at Zhongshan, styling [the state] Yan.
translations.idiomatic: Murong Jun declared himself emperor at Zhongshan and named his state Yan.

sentences.zh: 安西將軍謝尚帥姚襄與張遇戰于許昌之誡橋，王師敗績。

translations.literal: General Who Pacifies the West Xie Shang led Yao Xiang and Zhang Yu to battle at the Jie Bridge of Xuchang; the royal army was routed.
translations.idiomatic: Xie Shang, general pacifying the west, led Yao Xiang against Zhang Yu at the Jie Bridge outside Xuchang and suffered a rout.

sentences.zh: 苻健使其弟雄襲遇，虜之。

translations.literal: Fu Jian sent his younger brother Xiong to raid Yu and capture him.
translations.idiomatic: Fu Jian dispatched his brother Fu Xiong, who struck Zhang Yu and took him prisoner.

sentences.zh: 秋七月，大雩。

translations.literal: In autumn, the seventh month, a great rain prayer was held.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh autumn month the court held the great rain ceremony.

sentences.zh: 石季龍故將王擢遣使請降，拜征西將軍、秦州刺史。

translations.literal: The former general of Shi Jilong, Wang Zhuo, sent envoys requesting surrender; he was appointed general who campaigns west and governor of Qin.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Zhuo, once a commander under Shi Hu, asked to submit and was named general campaigning west and governor of Qin.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，以鎮軍大將軍、武陵王晞爲太宰，撫軍大將軍、會稽王昱爲司徒，征西大將軍桓溫爲太尉。

translations.literal: On dingyou, with Great General Who Stabilizes the Army, Prince Xi of Wuling, as grand tutor; General Who Nurtures the Army, Prince Hui of Kuaiji, as minister of education; Great General Who Campaigns West Huan Wen as grand commandant.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou Prince Xi of Wuling rose to grand tutor, Prince Hui of Kuaiji to minister of education, and Huan Wen to grand commandant.

sentences.zh: 八月，平西將軍周撫討蕭敬文于涪城，斬之。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, General Who Pacifies the West Zhou Fu campaigned against Xiao Jingwen at Fucheng and beheaded him.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month Zhou Fu, general pacifying the west, attacked Xiao Jingwen at Fucheng and executed him.

sentences.zh: 冉閔子智以鄴降，督護戴施獲其傳國璽，送之，文曰「受天之命，皇帝壽昌」，百僚畢賀。

translations.literal: The son of Ran Min, Zhi, surrendered Ye; Superintendent Dai Shi obtained his transmission seal and sent it; the inscription read “Receiving Heaven’s mandate, the emperor’s longevity flourishes”; the hundred officials all congratulated.
translations.idiomatic: Ran Zhi, Ran Min’s son, yielded Ye; Dai Shi, the protector, recovered the jade seal inscribed “By Heaven’s charge, long life to the emperor,” and the whole bureaucracy hailed the omen.

sentences.zh: 九月，冉智爲其將馬願所執，降于慕容恪。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, Ran Zhi was seized alive by his general Ma Yuan and surrendered to Murong Ke.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month Ran Zhi was seized by his own officer Ma Yuan and handed over to Murong Ke.

sentences.zh: 中軍將軍殷浩帥衆北伐，次泗口，遣河南太守戴施據石門，滎陽太守劉遂戍倉垣。

translations.literal: Central Army General Yin Hao led the host on a northern campaign, halted at Sikou, sent Governor of Henan Dai Shi to hold Shimen, and Prefect of Xingyang Liu Sui to garrison Cangyuan.
translations.idiomatic: Yin Hao, central army general, marched north to Sikou, ordered Dai Shi to secure Shimen, and Liu Sui to hold Cangyuan.

sentences.zh: 冬十月，秦州刺史王擢爲苻健所逼，奔于涼州。

translations.literal: In winter, the tenth month, Governor of Qin Wang Zhuo, pressed by Fu Jian, fled to Liang Province.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth winter month Wang Zhuo, governor of Qin, broke under pressure from Fu Jian and fled into Liang.

sentences.zh: 九年春正月乙卯朔，大赦。

translations.literal: In the ninth year, spring, the first month, on yimao, the first day of the month, a general amnesty was proclaimed.
translations.idiomatic: At new moon on yimao in the ninth year’s first spring month a general amnesty was declared.

sentences.zh: 張重華使王擢與苻健將苻雄戰，擢師敗績。

translations.literal: Zhang Chonghua sent Wang Zhuo to battle Fu Jian’s general Fu Xiong; Zhuo’s army was routed.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Chonghua sent Wang Zhuo against Fu Xiong and lost badly.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，皇太后與帝同拜建平陵。

translations.literal: On bingyin, the empress dowager and the emperor together paid respects at Jianping Mausoleum.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin the empress dowager and the emperor jointly visited Jianping Ling.

sentences.zh: 三月，旱。

translations.literal: In the third month, drought.
translations.idiomatic: The third month brought drought.

sentences.zh: 交州刺史阮敷討林邑范佛于日南，破其五十餘壘。

translations.literal: Governor of Jiao Ruan Fu campaigned against Fan Fo of Linyi at Rinan and broke more than fifty of his stockades.
translations.idiomatic: Ruan Fu, governor of Jiao, attacked Lin-yi’s Fan Fo in Rinan and over fifty of his fortified camps.

sentences.zh: 夏四月，以安西將軍謝尚爲尚書僕射。

translations.literal: In summer, the fourth month, with General Who Pacifies the West Xie Shang as vice director of the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth summer month Xie Shang, general pacifying the west, was appointed vice director of the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 五月，大疫。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, great pestilence.
translations.idiomatic: A fierce epidemic struck in the fifth month.

sentences.zh: 張重華復使王擢襲秦州，取之。

translations.literal: Zhang Chonghua again sent Wang Zhuo to raid Qin Province and took it.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Chonghua again dispatched Wang Zhuo, who seized Qin Province.

sentences.zh: 仇池公楊初爲苻雄所敗。

translations.literal: Duke of Qiuchi Yang Chu was defeated by Fu Xiong.
translations.idiomatic: Yang Chu, duke of Qiuchi, was beaten by Fu Xiong.

sentences.zh: 秋七月丁酉，地震，有聲如雷。

translations.literal: In autumn, the seventh month, on dingyou, there was an earthquake with sound like thunder.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou in the seventh autumn month the earth shook with a roar like thunder.

sentences.zh: 八月，遣兼太尉、河間王欽修復五陵。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, they sent concurrent Grand Commandant, Prince Qin of Hejian, to repair the five mausoleums.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month the Prince of Hejian, acting as grand commandant, was sent to restore the five tombs at Luoyang.

sentences.zh: 冬十月，中軍將軍殷浩進次山桑，使平北將軍姚襄爲前鋒，襄叛，反擊浩，浩棄輜重，退保譙城。

translations.literal: In winter, the tenth month, Central Army General Yin Hao advanced and halted at Shansang, sent General Who Pacifies the North Yao Xiang as vanguard; Xiang rebelled, turned and struck Hao; Hao abandoned baggage trains and withdrew to guard Qiao city.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth winter month Yin Hao pushed to Shansang and put Yao Xiang in the van; Yao Xiang mutinied, wheeled about, and routed Yin Hao, who abandoned his supply train and fell back to Qiao.

sentences.zh: 丁未，涼州牧張重華卒，子耀靈嗣。

translations.literal: On dingwei, Shepherd of Liang Zhang Chonghua died; his son Yaoling succeeded.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei Zhang Chonghua, governor of Liang, died and was succeeded by his son Zhang Yaoling.

sentences.zh: 是月，張祚弑耀靈而自稱涼州牧。

translations.literal: In that month, Zhang Zuo murdered Yaoling and himself styled Shepherd of Liang.
translations.idiomatic: That same month Zhang Zuo assassinated Yaoling and seized the title of governor of Liang.

sentences.zh: 十一月，殷浩使部將劉啓、王彬之討姚襄，復爲襄所敗，襄遂進據芍陂。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, Yin Hao sent subordinates Liu Qi and Wang Binzhi to campaign against Yao Xiang; again they were defeated by Xiang; Xiang thereupon advanced to occupy Shaopi.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month Yin Hao’s generals Liu Qi and Wang Binzhi attacked Yao Xiang but were crushed; Yao Xiang then moved onto Shaopi.

sentences.zh: 十二月，加尚書僕射謝尚爲都督豫、揚、江西諸軍事，領豫州刺史，鎮歷陽。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, Vice Director of the Secretariat Xie Shang was added supervisor of military affairs in Yu, Yang, and the west of the Jiang, concurrently governor of Yu, garrisoning Liyang.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month Xie Shang, vice director of the Secretariat, was given command over Yu, Yang, and Jiangxi, with concurrent governorship of Yu from a base at Liyang.

sentences.zh: 十年春正月己酉朔，帝臨朝，以五陵未復，懸而不樂。

translations.literal: In the tenth year, spring, the first month, on jiyou, the first day of the month, the emperor faced the court; because the five mausoleums were not yet restored, it was suspended and there was no music.
translations.idiomatic: At new moon on jiyou in the tenth year’s first spring month the emperor held court but, with the Luoyang tombs still unrestored, suspended music.

sentences.zh: 涼州牧張祚僭帝位。

translations.literal: Shepherd of Liang Zhang Zuo usurped the imperial position.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Zuo, governor of Liang, declared himself emperor.

sentences.zh: 冉閔降將周成舉兵反，自宛陵襲洛陽。

translations.literal: The surrendered general of Ran Min, Zhou Cheng, raised troops in revolt, and from Wanling raided Luoyang.
translations.idiomatic: Zhou Cheng, a defector from Ran Min’s ranks, rose in arms, marched from Wanling, and struck Luoyang.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，河南太守戴施奔鮪渚。

translations.literal: On xinyou, Prefect of Henan Dai Shi fled to Weizhu.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou Dai Shi, prefect of Henan, fled to Weizhu.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，地震，有聲如雷。

translations.literal: On dingmao, there was an earthquake with sound like thunder.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao the earth quaked with thunderous noise.

sentences.zh: 二月己丑，太尉、征西將軍桓溫帥師伐關中。

translations.literal: On jichou of the second month, Grand Commandant, General Who Campaigns West Huan Wen led the army to campaign against Guanzhong.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou in the second month Huan Wen, grand commandant and general campaigning west, marched into the Guanzhong heartland.

sentences.zh: 廢揚州刺史殷浩爲庶人，以前會稽內史王述爲揚州刺史。

translations.literal: Yangzhou Governor Yin Hao was dismissed to commoner status; with former administrator of the interior of Kuaiji Wang Shu as governor of Yang.
translations.idiomatic: Yin Hao was stripped of his post as governor of Yang and reduced to commoner rank; Wang Shu, formerly interior administrator of Kuaiji, replaced him.

sentences.zh: 夏四月己亥，溫及苻健子萇戰于藍田，大敗之。

translations.literal: In summer, the fourth month, on jihai, Wen and Fu Jian’s son Chang battled at Lantian and greatly defeated him.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai in the fourth summer month Huan Wen met Fu Chang, Fu Jian’s son, at Lantian and won a decisive victory.

sentences.zh: 五月，江西乞活郭敞等執陳留內史劉仕而叛，京師震駭，以吏部尚書周閔爲中軍將軍，屯于中堂，豫州刺史謝尚自歷陽還衛京師。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, qihu bands west of the Jiang, Guo Chang and others, seized Administrator of Chenliu Liu Shi and rebelled; the capital region was shaken; with Minister of Personnel Zhou Min as central army general, encamped at the Central Hall; Governor of Yu Xie Shang returned from Liyang to guard the capital region.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month qihu survivor bands west of the River, led by Guo Chang, seized Liu Shi, administrator of Chenliu, and mutinied, throwing the capital into alarm; Zhou Min, minister of personnel, was made central army general and camped in the central hall, while Xie Shang hurried back from Liyang to shield the capital.

sentences.zh: 六月，苻健將苻雄悉衆及桓溫戰于白鹿原，王師敗績。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, Fu Jian’s general Fu Xiong led the full host and with Huan Wen battled at Bailuyuan; the royal army was routed.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month Fu Xiong brought Fu Jian’s whole army against Huan Wen at Bailuyuan and routed the Jin force.

sentences.zh: 秋九月辛酉，桓溫糧盡，引還。

translations.literal: In autumn, the ninth month, on xinyou, Huan Wen’s provisions were exhausted; he led [the army] back.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou in the ninth autumn month Huan Wen, out of supplies, withdrew.

sentences.zh: 夏四月壬申，隕霜。

translations.literal: In summer, the fourth month, on renshen, frost fell from the sky.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen in the fourth summer month killing frost descended.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，地震。

translations.literal: On yiyou, there was an earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou the earth shook.

sentences.zh: 姚襄帥衆寇外黃，冠軍將軍高季大破之。

translations.literal: Yao Xiang led the host to raid Waihuang; General Who Vanquishes Champions Gao Ji greatly broke him.
translations.idiomatic: Yao Xiang raided Waihuang but Gao Ji, general who vanquishes champions, shattered his force.

sentences.zh: 五月丁未，地又震。

translations.literal: On dingwei of the fifth month, the earth again quaked.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei in the fifth month another earthquake struck.

sentences.zh: 六月，苻健死，其子生嗣偽位。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, Fu Jian died; his son Sheng succeeded to the false position.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month Fu Jian died and his son Fu Sheng inherited the usurper’s throne.

sentences.zh: 秋七月，宋混、張瓘弑張祚，而立耀靈弟玄靚爲大將軍、涼州牧，遣使來降。

translations.literal: In autumn, the seventh month, Song Hun and Zhang Guan murdered Zhang Zuo and established Yaoling’s younger brother Xuanjing as great general and shepherd of Liang, sending envoys to come surrender.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh autumn month Song Hun and Zhang Guan killed Zhang Zuo and set Zhang Xuanjing, Yaoling’s younger brother, over Liang as great general and governor, then sent envoys to submit to Jin.

sentences.zh: 以吏部尚書周閔爲尚書左僕射，領軍將軍王彪之爲尚書右僕射。

translations.literal: With Minister of Personnel Zhou Min as left vice director of the Secretariat, and General Who Commands the Army Wang Bianzhi as right vice director of the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: Zhou Min became left vice director of the Secretariat and Wang Bianzhi, general commanding the army, right vice director.

sentences.zh: 冬十月，進豫州刺史謝尚督幷冀幽三州諸軍事、鎮西將軍，鎮馬頭。

translations.literal: In winter, the tenth month, Governor of Yu Xie Shang was advanced supervisor of military affairs in the three provinces of Bing, Ji, and You, General Who Pacifies the West, garrisoning Matou.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth winter month Xie Shang was promoted to supervise Bing, Ji, and You as general pacifying the west, based at Matou.

sentences.zh: 十二月，慕容恪帥衆寇廣固。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, Murong Ke led the host to raid Guanggu.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month Murong Ke marched against Guanggu.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，上黨人馮鴦自稱太守，背苻生遣使來降。

translations.literal: On renxu, Feng Yuan of Shangdang styled himself prefect, turned his back on Fu Sheng, and sent envoys to come surrender.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu Feng Yuan of Shangdang declared himself prefect, broke with Fu Sheng, and offered allegiance to Jin.

sentences.zh: 十二年春正月丁卯，帝臨朝，以皇太后母喪，懸而不樂。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year, spring, the first month, on dingmao, the emperor faced the court; because of the empress dowager’s mother’s mourning, it was suspended and there was no music.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao in the twelfth year’s first spring month the emperor held court but, mourning the empress dowager’s mother, forwent music.

sentences.zh: 鎮北將軍段龕及慕容恪戰于廣固，大敗之，恪退據安平。

translations.literal: General Who Stabilizes the North Duan Kan and Murong Ke fought at Guanggu; [Kan] greatly defeated him [Ke]; Ke withdrew to occupy Anping.
translations.idiomatic: Duan Kan, general stabilizing the north, met Murong Ke at Guanggu and routed him; Murong Ke drew back to Anping.

sentences.zh: 二月辛丑，帝講《孝經》。

translations.literal: On xinchou of the second month, the emperor lectured on the Classic of Filial Piety.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou in the second month the emperor lectured on the Classic of Filial Piety.

sentences.zh: 三月，姚襄入于許昌，以太尉桓溫爲征討大都督以討之。

translations.literal: In the third month, Yao Xiang entered Xuchang; with Grand Commandant Huan Wen as grand commander of conquest to campaign against him.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month Yao Xiang occupied Xuchang, and Huan Wen was named supreme commander of punitive expeditions to bring him to heel.

sentences.zh: 秋八月己亥，桓溫及姚襄戰于伊水，大敗之，襄走平陽，徙其餘衆三千餘家于江漢之間，執周成而歸。

translations.literal: In autumn, the eighth month, on jihai, Huan Wen and Yao Xiang battled at the Yi River, greatly defeated him; Xiang fled to Pingyang, relocated his remaining host of more than three thousand households between the Jiang and the Han, seized Zhou Cheng, and returned.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai in the eighth autumn month Huan Wen crushed Yao Xiang at the Yi River; Yao fled toward Pingyang while more than three thousand of his households were resettled between the Yangzi and the Han, and Zhou Cheng was taken captive for the march home.

sentences.zh: 使揚武將軍毛穆之，督護陳午，輔國將軍、河南太守戴施鎮洛陽。

translations.literal: They sent General Who Rouses Martial Prowess Mao Muzhi, Superintendent Chen Wu, General Who Supports the State and Prefect of Henan Dai Shi to garrison Luoyang.
translations.idiomatic: Mao Muzhi, Chen Wu, and Dai Shi were ordered to hold Luoyang—the first as general rousing martial prowess, the second as protector, the third as general supporting the state and prefect of Henan.

sentences.zh: 冬十月癸巳朔，日有蝕之。

translations.literal: In winter, the tenth month, on guisi, the first day of the month, there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: At new moon on guisi in the tenth winter month the sun was eclipsed.

sentences.zh: 慕容恪攻段龕於廣固，使北中郎將荀羨帥師次于琅邪以救之。

translations.literal: Murong Ke attacked Duan Kan at Guanggu, and sent North Central Commandant Xun Xian to lead the army to halt at Langye to rescue him.
translations.idiomatic: Murong Ke besieged Duan Kan at Guanggu while Xun Xian, north central commandant, was sent toward Langye in a relief effort.

sentences.zh: 十一月，遣兼司空、散騎常侍車灌，龍驤將軍袁眞等持節如洛陽，修五陵。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, they sent concurrent Minister of Works, cavalier attendant for regular service Che Guan, General of Dragon Martial Yuan Zhen, and others, bearing credentials to Luoyang to repair the five mausoleums.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month Che Guan, acting minister of works, Yuan Zhen, dragon martial general, and others went to Luoyang with the staff of authority to restore the five tombs.

sentences.zh: 十二月庚戌，以有事于五陵，告于太廟，帝及羣臣皆服緦，于太極殿臨三日。

translations.literal: On gengxu of the twelfth month, because there was business at the five mausoleums, it was announced at the Grand Temple; the emperor and the host of ministers all wore fine hemp, and at the Hall of Supreme Ultimate faced [the matter] for three days.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu in the twelfth month, with rites pending at the five tombs, the court reported to the imperial temple; emperor and ministers wore the finest mourning grade and kept vigil three days in the Taiji Hall.

sentences.zh: 是歲，仇池公楊國爲其從父俊所殺，俊自立。

translations.literal: In this year, Duke of Qiuchi Yang Guo was killed by his paternal cousin Jun; Jun established himself.
translations.idiomatic: That year Yang Guo, duke of Qiuchi, was murdered by his cousin Yang Jun, who then seized power.

sentences.zh: 三月，帝講《孝經》。

translations.literal: In the third month, the emperor lectured on the Classic of Filial Piety.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month the emperor again lectured on the Classic of Filial Piety.

sentences.zh: 壬申，親釋奠于中堂。

translations.literal: On renshen, he personally performed the libation for the teacher at the Central Hall.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen he personally offered the teacher’s libation in the central hall.

sentences.zh: 夏五月庚午，鎮西將軍謝尚卒。

translations.literal: In summer, the fifth month, on gengwu, General Who Pacifies the West Xie Shang died.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu in the fifth summer month Xie Shang, general pacifying the west, died.

sentences.zh: 苻生將苻眉、苻堅擊姚襄，戰於三原，斬之。

translations.literal: Fu Sheng’s generals Fu Mei and Fu Jian attacked Yao Xiang, battled at Sanyuan, and beheaded him.
translations.idiomatic: Fu Mei and Fu Jian, generals of Fu Sheng, caught Yao Xiang at Sanyuan and struck off his head.

sentences.zh: 六月，苻堅殺苻生而自立。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, Fu Jian killed Fu Sheng and established himself.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month Fu Jian slew Fu Sheng and took the throne.

sentences.zh: 以軍司謝奕爲使持節、都督、安西將軍、豫州刺史。

translations.literal: With army supervisor Xie Yi as bearer of credentials, commander-in-chief, General Who Pacifies the West, and governor of Yu.
translations.idiomatic: Xie Yi, army supervisor, was appointed credential-holder, area commander, general pacifying the west, and governor of Yu.

sentences.zh: 秋七月，苻堅將張平以幷州降，遂以爲幷州刺史。

translations.literal: In autumn, the seventh month, Fu Jian’s general Zhang Ping came with Bing Province to surrender; thereupon he was made governor of Bing.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh autumn month Zhang Ping, a general of Fu Jian’s, surrendered Bing Province and was confirmed as its governor.

sentences.zh: 八月丁未，立皇后何氏，大赦，賜孝悌鰥寡米，人五斛，逋租宿債皆勿收，大酺三日。

translations.literal: On dingwei of the eighth month, they established Empress He; a general amnesty was proclaimed; filial and frugal, widowed and solitary were given grain, five hu per person; overdue rent and long-standing debts were all not collected; great feasting for three days.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei in the eighth month Lady He was enthroned as empress, a general amnesty was issued, the virtuous and needy received five hu of grain each, old taxes and debts were forgiven, and the capital feasted for three days.

sentences.zh: 冬十月，皇后見於太廟。

translations.literal: In winter, the tenth month, the empress had audience at the Grand Temple.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth winter month the new empress was presented at the imperial temple.

sentences.zh: 十一月，雷。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, thunder.
translations.idiomatic: Thunder rolled in the eleventh month.

sentences.zh: 十二月，乙太常王彪之爲尚書左僕射。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, with Grand Master of Ceremonies Wang Bianzhi as left vice director of the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month Wang Bianzhi, minister of ceremonials, was appointed left vice director of the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 二年春正月，司徒、會稽王昱稽首歸政，帝不許。

translations.literal: In the second year, spring, the first month, the minister of education, Prince Hui of Kuaiji, kowtowed to return the government; the emperor did not permit.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year’s first spring month Prince Hui of Kuaiji, who held the post of minister of education, begged to yield the regency, but the emperor refused.

sentences.zh: 三月，慕容儁陷冀州諸郡，詔安西將軍謝奕、北中郎將荀羨北伐。

translations.literal: In the third month, Murong Jun took the commanderies of Ji; an edict ordered General Who Pacifies the West Xie Yi and North Central Commandant Xun Xian to campaign north.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month Murong Jun overran Ji Province; the court ordered Xie Yi and Xun Xian to march north against him.

sentences.zh: 三月，佽飛督王饒獻鴆鳥，帝怒，鞭之二百，使殿中御史焚其鳥于四達之衢。

translations.literal: In the third month, Cifei supervisor Wang Rao presented a zhen bird; the emperor was angry, flogged him two hundred strokes, and ordered a palace censor to burn the bird at a four-road crossroads.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Rao, overseer of the cifei guard, offered a zhen poison-fowl; the emperor, enraged, had him flogged two hundred times and the bird burned at a public crossroads.

sentences.zh: 夏五月，大水。

translations.literal: In summer, the fifth month, great flooding.
translations.idiomatic: The fifth summer month brought severe floods.

sentences.zh: 有星孛于天船。

translations.literal: There was a broom star in the Celestial Boat.
translations.idiomatic: A comet appeared in the lodge Celestial Boat.

sentences.zh: 六月，幷州刺史張平爲苻堅所逼，帥衆三千奔于平陽，堅追敗之。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, Governor of Bing Zhang Ping, pressed by Fu Jian, led three thousand of the host to flee to Pingyang; Jian pursued and defeated him.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month Zhang Ping, governor of Bing, broke under Fu Jian’s pressure and fled toward Pingyang with three thousand men; Fu Jian overtook him and won a victory.

sentences.zh: 慕容恪進據上黨，冠軍將軍馮鴦以衆叛歸慕容儁，儁盡陷河北之地。

translations.literal: Murong Ke advanced to occupy Shangdang; General Who Vanquishes Champions Feng Yuan with the host rebelled and returned to Murong Jun; Jun entirely took the lands north of the He.
translations.idiomatic: Murong Ke moved into Shangdang; Feng Yuan, general who vanquishes champions, defected with his troops to Murong Jun, who then overran the whole north of the Yellow River.

sentences.zh: 秋八月，安西將軍謝奕卒。

translations.literal: In autumn, the eighth month, General Who Pacifies the West Xie Yi died.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth autumn month Xie Yi, general pacifying the west, died.

sentences.zh: 壬申，以吳興太守謝萬爲西中郎將、持節、監司豫冀幷四州諸軍事、豫州刺史。

translations.literal: On renshen, with Prefect of Wuxing Xie Wan as general of the west central command, bearer of credentials, supervisor of military affairs in the four provinces of Si, Yu, Ji, and Bing, and governor of Yu.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen Xie Wan, prefect of Wuxing, was named general of the central west command, given the staff, and placed over Si, Yu, Ji, and Bing as governor of Yu.

sentences.zh: 以散騎常侍郗曇爲北中郎將、持節、都督徐兗青冀幽五州諸軍事、徐兗二州刺史，鎮下邳。

translations.literal: With cavalier attendant for regular service Xi Tan as north central commandant, bearer of credentials, commander-in-chief of military affairs in the five provinces of Xu, Yan, Qing, Ji, and You, and governor of the two provinces Xu and Yan, garrisoning Xiapi.
translations.idiomatic: Xi Tan, cavalier attendant for regular service, became north central commandant with credentials, commander over Xu, Yan, Qing, Ji, and You, dual governor of Xu and Yan, and was posted to Xiapi.

sentences.zh: 十一月庚子，雷。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on gengzi, thunder.
translations.idiomatic: Thunder sounded on gengzi in the eleventh month.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，地震。

translations.literal: On xinyou, there was an earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou the earth shook.

sentences.zh: 十二月，北中郎將荀羨及慕容儁戰于山荏，王師敗績。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, North Central Commandant Xun Xian and Murong Jun battled at Shanren; the royal army was routed.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month Xun Xian met Murong Jun at Shanren; the imperial army was routed.

sentences.zh: 三年春三月甲辰，詔以比年出軍，糧運不繼，王公已下十三戶借一人一年助運。

translations.literal: In the third year, spring, third month, on jiachen, an edict ordered that because in recent years the army had gone out and grain transport had not kept up, from princes and dukes downward one person per thirteen households should be lent for one year to assist transport.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year’s third spring month, on jiachen, an edict required every thirteen households from princely rank down to supply one laborer for a year to help move army grain.

sentences.zh: 秋七月，平北將軍高昌爲慕容儁所逼，自白馬奔于滎陽。

translations.literal: In autumn, the seventh month, General Who Pacifies the North Gao Chang, pressed by Murong Jun, fled from Baima to Xingyang.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh autumn month Gao Chang, general pacifying the north, fled Murong Jun’s advance from Baima to Xingyang.

sentences.zh: 冬十月慕容儁寇東阿，遣西中郎將謝萬次下蔡，北中郎將郗曇次高平以擊之，王師敗績。

translations.literal: In winter, the tenth month Murong Jun raided Dong’e; they sent General of the West Central Command Xie Wan to halt at Xiacai, North Central Commandant Xi Tan to halt at Gaoping to strike him; the royal army was routed.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth winter month Murong Jun struck Dong’e; Jin sent Xie Wan toward Xiacai and Xi Tan toward Gaoping to counterattack, but the imperial force was defeated.

sentences.zh: 十一月戊子，進揚州刺史王述爲衛將軍。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on wuzi, Governor of Yang Wang Shu was advanced to general who guards the court.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi in the eleventh month Wang Shu, governor of Yang, was promoted to general guarding the court.

sentences.zh: 十二月，又以中軍將軍、琅邪王丕爲驃騎將軍，東海王奕爲車騎將軍。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, again with Central Army General, Prince of Langye Pi, as general of agile cavalry, and Prince of Donghai Yi as general of chariots and cavalry.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month Prince Pi of Langye was raised to agile cavalry general and Prince Yi of Donghai to general of chariots and cavalry.

sentences.zh: 封武陵王晞子㻱爲梁王。

translations.literal: They enfeoffed the son of Prince Xi of Wuling, 㻱, as prince of Liang.
translations.idiomatic: The son of Prince Xi of Wuling, whose name is written 㻱, was invested as prince of Liang.

sentences.zh: 交州刺史溫放之帥兵討林邑參黎、耽潦，並降之。

translations.literal: Governor of Jiao Wen Fangzhi led troops to campaign against the Lin-yi places Canli and Danlao, and both submitted.
translations.idiomatic: Wen Fangzhi, governor of Jiao, campaigned against Lin-yi’s outposts at Canli and Danlao and reduced both.

sentences.zh: 四年春正月，仇池公楊俊卒，子世嗣。

translations.literal: In the fourth year, spring, the first month, Duke of Qiuchi Yang Jun died; his son Shi succeeded.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year’s first spring month Yang Jun, duke of Qiuchi, died and was succeeded by his son Yang Shi.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，慕容儁死，子暐嗣偽位。

translations.literal: On bingxu, Murong Jun died; his son Wei succeeded to the false position.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu Murong Jun died and his son Murong Wei inherited the Yan throne.

sentences.zh: 二月，鳳皇將九雛見于豐城。

translations.literal: In the second month, a phoenix leading nine chicks was seen at Fengcheng.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month a phoenix with nine fledglings was sighted at Fengcheng.

sentences.zh: 秋七月，以軍役繁興，省用撤膳。

translations.literal: In autumn, the seventh month, because military corvée had multiplied, they reduced expenditures and withdrew palace meals.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh autumn month, with conscription and labor heavy, the court cut spending and curtailed palace kitchens.

sentences.zh: 八月辛丑朔，日有蝕之，旣。

translations.literal: On xinchou of the eighth month, the first day of the month, there was a solar eclipse; it was total.
translations.idiomatic: At new moon on xinchou in the eighth month the sun was eclipsed to totality.

sentences.zh: 冬十月，天狗流于西南。

translations.literal: In winter, the tenth month, a “celestial dog” flowed toward the southwest.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth winter month a meteoric “heavenly dog” streaked into the southwest sky.

sentences.zh: 十一月，封太尉桓溫爲南郡公，溫弟沖爲豐城縣公，子濟爲臨賀郡公。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, they enfeoffed Grand Commandant Huan Wen as duke of Nan commandery, Wen’s younger brother Chong as duke of Fengcheng county, and his son Ji as duke of Linhe commandery.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month Huan Wen was ennobled duke of Nan, his brother Huan Chong duke of Fengcheng county, and his son Huan Ji duke of Linhe.

sentences.zh: 鳳皇復見豐城，衆鳥隨之。

translations.literal: The phoenix again appeared at Fengcheng; a multitude of birds followed it.
translations.idiomatic: The phoenix appeared again at Fengcheng, followed by flocks of other birds.

sentences.zh: 五年春正月戊戌，大赦，賜鰥寡孤獨不能自存者，人米五斛。

translations.literal: In the fifth year, spring, the first month, on wuxu, a general amnesty was proclaimed; widowers, widows, orphans, and the childless unable to support themselves were given grain, five hu per person.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu in the fifth year’s first spring month a general amnesty was declared and five hu of grain was issued to each indigent widow, widower, orphan, or childless elder.

sentences.zh: 北中郎將、都督徐兗青冀幽五州諸軍事、徐兗二州刺史郗曇卒。

translations.literal: North Central Commandant, commander-in-chief of military affairs in the five provinces of Xu, Yan, Qing, Ji, and You, and governor of the two provinces Xu and Yan, Xi Tan, died.
translations.idiomatic: Xi Tan died—he had been north central commandant, commander over Xu, Yan, Qing, Ji, and You, and dual governor of Xu and Yan.

sentences.zh: 二月，以鎮軍將軍范汪爲都督徐兗青冀幽五州諸軍事、安北將軍、徐兗二州刺史。

translations.literal: In the second month, with General Who Stabilizes the Army Fan Wang as commander-in-chief of military affairs in the five provinces of Xu, Yan, Qing, Ji, and You, General Who Pacifies the North, and governor of the two provinces Xu and Yan.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month Fan Wang, general stabilizing the army, took command of Xu, Yan, Qing, Ji, and You as general pacifying the north and dual governor of Xu and Yan.

sentences.zh: 平南將軍、廣州刺史、陽夏侯滕含卒。

translations.literal: General Who Pacifies the South, governor of Guang, and village marquis of Yangxia Teng Han died.
translations.idiomatic: Teng Han died—general pacifying the south, governor of Guang, and marquis of Yangxia.

sentences.zh: 夏四月，大水。

translations.literal: In summer, the fourth month, great flooding.
translations.idiomatic: The fourth summer month brought major floods.

sentences.zh: 太尉桓溫鎮宛，使其弟豁將兵取許昌。

translations.literal: Grand Commandant Huan Wen garrisoned Wan, and sent his younger brother Huo to lead troops to take Xuchang.
translations.idiomatic: Huan Wen, grand commandant, based himself at Wan while his brother Huan Huo seized Xuchang.

sentences.zh: 鳳皇見于沔北。

translations.literal: The phoenix was seen north of the Mian.
translations.idiomatic: A phoenix was sighted north of the Han River.

sentences.zh: 五月丁巳，帝崩于顯陽殿，時年十九。

translations.literal: On dingsi of the fifth month, the emperor died in the Hall of Manifest Yang; at the time he was nineteen sui.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi in the fifth month the emperor died in the Xianyang Hall at the age of nineteen.

sentences.zh: 葬永平陵，廟號孝宗。

translations.literal: He was buried at Yongping Mausoleum; the temple name was Xiaozong.
translations.idiomatic: He was interred at Yongping Ling and given the temple name Xiaozong.

sentences.zh: 哀皇帝諱丕，字千齡，成帝長子也。

translations.literal: The Lamented Emperor had the taboo name Pi, courtesy name Qianling, and was the eldest son of Emperor Cheng.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Ai, personal name Pi and courtesy name Qianling, was Emperor Cheng’s eldest son.

sentences.zh: 咸康八年，封爲琅邪王。

translations.literal: In the eighth year of Xiankang, he was enfeoffed as prince of Langye.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth Xiankang year he was invested prince of Langye.

sentences.zh: 永和元年拜散騎常侍，十二年加中軍將軍，升平三年除驃騎將軍。

translations.literal: In the first year of Yonghe he was appointed cavalier attendant for regular service; in the twelfth year he was added central army general; in the third year of Shengping he was appointed general of agile cavalry.
translations.idiomatic: He became cavalier attendant for regular service in the first Yonghe year, central army general in the twelfth Yonghe year, and agile cavalry general in the third Shengping year.

sentences.zh: 五年五月丁巳，穆帝崩。

translations.literal: On dingsi of the fifth month of the fifth year, Emperor Mu died.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi in the fifth month of the fifth year Emperor Mu passed away.

sentences.zh: 皇太后令曰：「帝奄不救疾，胤嗣未建。

translations.literal: The empress dowager issued an order saying: “The emperor has suddenly succumbed to an incurable illness; the heir has not yet been established.
translations.idiomatic: The empress dowager proclaimed: “The sovereign has been taken by a sudden fatal illness, and no heir has been named.

sentences.zh: 琅邪王丕，中興正統，明德懋親。

translations.literal: The Prince of Langye Pi is the legitimate line of the restoration, of brilliant virtue and honored kinship.
translations.idiomatic: Prince Pi of Langye stands in the legitimate succession of the restored house, a man of shining virtue and the closest royal kin.

sentences.zh: 昔在咸康，屬當儲貳。

translations.literal: Formerly in Xiankang, he belonged to the position of heir apparent.
translations.idiomatic: Already in the Xiankang era he was marked for the heir apparent’s place.

sentences.zh: 以年在幼沖，未堪國難，故顯宗高讓。

translations.literal: Because his years were still young and tender, he could not bear the state’s hardships; therefore Emperor Cheng, temple name Xianzong, made the lofty gesture of yielding.
translations.idiomatic: Because he was still a child, the court judged him unable to bear the realm’s troubles, and Emperor Cheng therefore passed the succession to another branch.

sentences.zh: 今義望情地，莫與爲比，其以王奉大統。

translations.literal: Now in righteous expectation and standing none may compare with him; with the prince receive the great line.
translations.idiomatic: Now, in public standing and moral claim, none can rival him; let the prince receive the great mandate.

sentences.zh: 」于是百官備法駕，迎于琅邪第。

translations.literal: ” Thereupon the hundred officials prepared the imperial chariot and welcomed him at the Langye princely residence.
translations.idiomatic: ” The full bureaucracy arrayed the imperial equipage and escorted him from the Langye princely mansion.

sentences.zh: 庚申，卽皇帝位，大赦。

translations.literal: On gengshen, he assumed the imperial throne; a general amnesty was proclaimed.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen he ascended the throne and proclaimed a general amnesty.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，詔曰：「朕獲承明命，入纂大統。

translations.literal: On renxu, an edict said: “We have received the bright charge and entered to continue the great line.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu he issued an edict: “We have received the luminous mandate and entered upon the great succession.

sentences.zh: 顧惟先王宗廟，蒸嘗無主，太妃喪庭，廓然靡寄，悲痛感摧，五內抽割。

translations.literal: But considering the ancestral temples of the former kings, the seasonal offerings have no master; the Grand Consort’s mourning hall stands empty with nowhere to lodge offerings; grief and pain crush us, and the five viscera are torn asunder.
translations.idiomatic: Yet the shrines of our late sovereigns lack a chief mourner for their sacrifices, and the hall where the Grand Consort lies is desolate with nowhere to lodge our grief; sorrow rends our very vitals.

sentences.zh: 宗國之尊，情禮兼隆，胤嗣之重，義無與二。

translations.literal: The honor of the ancestral state, in affection and rite alike, is lofty; the weight of the heir, in righteousness, admits no second.
translations.idiomatic: The dignity of the imperial clan demands the fullest rites of affection, and the burden of the succession allows no rival claimant.

sentences.zh: 東海王奕，戚屬親近，宜奉本統，其以奕爲琅邪王。」

translations.literal: The Prince of Donghai Yi, in kinship close at hand, ought to uphold the root line; with Yi as Prince of Langye.”
translations.idiomatic: Prince Yi of Donghai is our nearest kinsman and should carry the original princely line; let Yi be invested Prince of Langye.”

sentences.zh: 秋七月戊午，葬穆皇帝于永平陵。

translations.literal: In autumn, the seventh month, on wuwu, they buried Emperor Mu at Yongping Mausoleum.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu in the seventh autumn month Emperor Mu was buried at Yongping Ling.

sentences.zh: 慕容恪攻陷野王，守將呂護退保滎陽。

translations.literal: Murong Ke attacked and took Yewang; the defending general Lu Hu withdrew to guard Xingyang.
translations.idiomatic: Murong Ke captured Yewang; Lu Hu, the garrison commander, fell back to Xingyang.

sentences.zh: 八月己卯夜，天裂，廣數丈，有聲如雷。

translations.literal: On jimao of the eighth month, in the night, Heaven split; it was several zhang in breadth, and there was sound like thunder.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao in the eighth month the night sky seemed to split open for several zhang with a roar like thunder.

sentences.zh: 九月戊申，立皇后王氏。

translations.literal: On wushen of the ninth month, they established Empress Wang.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen in the ninth month Lady Wang was enthroned as empress.

sentences.zh: 穆帝皇后何氏稱永安宮。

translations.literal: Empress He of Emperor Mu was styled Yong’an Palace.
translations.idiomatic: Empress Dowager He, consort of Emperor Mu, was given the title of the Yong’an palace.

sentences.zh: 呂護叛奔于慕容暐。

translations.literal: Lu Hu rebelled and fled to Murong Wei.
translations.idiomatic: Lu Hu mutinied and defected to Murong Wei.

sentences.zh: 冬十月，安北將軍范汪有罪，廢爲庶人。

translations.literal: In winter, the tenth month, General Who Pacifies the North Fan Wang had a crime and was dismissed to commoner status.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth winter month Fan Wang, general pacifying the north, was found guilty and reduced to commoner rank.

sentences.zh: 十一月丙辰，詔曰：「顯宗成皇帝顧命，以時事多艱，弘高世之風，樹德博重，以隆社稷。

translations.literal: On bingchen of the eleventh month, an edict said: “Emperor Cheng’s testament, because the times’ affairs were many and hard, spread the air of a lofty age, planted virtue broadly and heavily, thereby to exalt the altars of soil and grain.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen in the eleventh month an edict recalled how Emperor Cheng’s dying charge, in an age of hardship, had urged a lofty style of rule and deep virtue to strengthen the dynasty.

sentences.zh: 而國故不巳，康穆早世，胤祚不融。

translations.literal: But the state’s misfortunes did not cease; Kang and Mu passed away early; the heir’s fortune did not flourish.
translations.idiomatic: Yet calamity did not end; Emperors Kang and Mu died young, and the succession faltered.

sentences.zh: 朕以寡德，復承先緒，感惟永慕，悲育兼摧。

translations.literal: We, with scant virtue, again inherit the prior thread; moved, we think forever with longing; grief and nurture alike crush us.
